of.needed: whether the environment routes traffic through waypoints (the evidence names waypoints but does not state how waypoint usage is identified in configuration)

consequence.statement: DestinationRule portLevelSettings that were previously ignored are now applied for waypoints, so configured per-port traffic policy takes effect for traffic routed through waypoints where it previously had no effect.
consequence.remediation: Review any portLevelSettings configured in DestinationRules for waypoint-routed services to confirm the intended per-port traffic policy, since these settings will now be applied rather than ignored.

assertion.statement: Istio 1.24.0 fixes an issue that caused any portLevelSettings in DestinationRules to be ignored for waypoints, so these per-port traffic policy settings are now honored for waypoint traffic.
